headline: ArcBest Reports Q3 Earnings Beat as Revenue Matches Estimates
summary: ArcBest Corp reported third-quarter earnings that beat analyst expectations by $0.14 per share, while revenue was in line with estimates.
why: Logistics and freight transportation providers serve as key economic bellwethers, reflecting broader trends in manufacturing, consumer demand, and supply chain activity.

impacts.name: ArcBest Corp
impacts.why: An earnings per share beat signals better-than-expected profitability relative to consensus estimates.
